steps.en: Officer revives a notice that was already paid
steps.id: Officer me-revive notice yang sudah dibayar

steps.en: System checks the notice was paid and finds the payment receipt
steps.id: Sistem memastikan notice sudah dibayar dan mencari receipt pembayaran
steps.why_en: Paid status is judged from one field, and migrated notices get a made-up receipt number.
steps.why_id: Status bayar dinilai dari satu field, dan notice hasil migrasi diberi nomor receipt buatan.

steps.en: A refund record is created with receipt, amount and reason
steps.id: Catatan refund dibuat berisi receipt, jumlah, dan alasan
steps.why_en: If creating the record fails it is only logged, and the officer still sees success.
steps.why_id: Kalau pembuatan catatan gagal, hanya di-log dan officer tetap melihat sukses.

steps.en: The refund record is sent to the Cumulus system
steps.id: Catatan refund dikirim ke sistem Cumulus
steps.why_en: Nothing in the code sends refund data to Cumulus.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada code yang mengirim data refund ke Cumulus.

steps.en: Staff are told about the refund so they can act on it
steps.id: Staf diberi tahu soal refund supaya bisa menindaklanjuti
steps.why_en: Only a daily and monthly email lists refunds; no refund is executed or tracked in OCMS.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada email harian dan bulanan yang mendaftar refund; tidak ada refund yang dieksekusi atau dilacak di OCMS.
